newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 17.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- New Palestinian stock exchange to open in mid-January.
- Japan extends $160 million loan to Tunisia for infrastructure projects.
- Yemen expects $1 billion foreign support for reforms, premier says.
- Yemen intends to form higher committee for privatisation.
- India seeks two million tonnes a year of natural gas from Qatar.
- German investors examine three Egyptian projects worth $700 million.
